bounded_invariant_pinned_correction06.operational_form: A CommandJob is CLEAN_TERMINAL iff its CommandJobState is one of { exited, deadline_exceeded, cancelled, spawn_failed } (NOT containment_failed) AND its postcondition probe in finalize() returned 'gone'. The deferred state assignment in finalize() guarantees containment_failed is the stored state on any non-gone postcondition, so the bounded invariant holds by construction. command_job_terminal_committed fires exactly once on CLEAN_TERMINAL; command_job_containment_failed fires exactly once on the failure path AFTER active.delete (gauge-conservation event).
